_comment: The NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls and FedRAMP 20x KSIs the retirement plan's evidence supports. Program design: the assessor decides each control; KSIs are FedRAMP's provider indicators the agency lines its evidence up with. Pairs, from Book 13 Appendix A: CM-8 with KSI-PIY-GIV, AC-2(3) with KSI-IAM-AAM (AC-2 itself carries none), CM-3 with KSI-CMT-LMC; CA-3, SR-12 and SI-12 carry none.
